notes.title: UPDATE NOTICE : v1.2 New weapons, maps and more!
notes.content:
[h1]Due to critical issues, we have rolled back certain features from v1.2 temporarily.
[/h1]

[b]Greetings Soldiers![/b]

We have a big update for you guys today!  Battle it out in the Pacific Theater with new weapons and maps! 

The BOT system has also be updated, lobby host can now choose the BOTs army and difficulty from the lobby menu. 

With this update we also have added a game mode that many of you have been asking for: Limited Weapons mode. The lobby host now has the ability to turn off and restrict weapons to open up games modes such as Snipers only. 

Let us know what you guys think of the update and what you would like to see in the future! 

As always, we are continually trying to fine-tune our game and listening to your feedback! Please let us know what you guys think and keep sending the constructive feedback and ideas our way.

notes.title: v1.0 Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31409256/9efdbd02390634ea664d613b20785c392bed0769.gif[/img]

[b]Greetings Soldiers![/b]

We have a quite a big update for the veterans of the game today! 

We are happy to announce our ranking and medal system along with a revamped weapon system. 

All the current weapons have been updated to include a bolt action or cocking feature which will be required after the gun has been reloaded. 

We really wanted to include the feature that lets players hold the weapon from the front with either hand so that they can reload with the main hand. We are working on pushing this out and it should be out within a month. In the meantime, we hope that players can familiarize themselves with the revamped weapons. 

The next update will be a big one and we hope to have your continued support

As always, we are continually trying to fine-tune our game and listening to your feedback! Please let us know what you guys think and keep sending the constructive feedback and ideas our way. 

Here’s the full list of updates below. 

[b]Ranking System:[/b]

notes.title: How To Play Front Defense: Heroes on Windows Mixed Reality (WMR)
notes.content:
Hi all, 

We now offically support the WMR headsets with SteamVR please check the instructions below if you have issues setting up your device. 

1.	Make sure your PC is compatible with WMR you can check here: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/mixed-reality/enthusiast-guide/windows-mixed-reality-minimum-pc-hardware-compatibility-guidelines

2.	Make sure Windows 10 is up-to-date. You can check here to see how to update windows: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/help/4027667/windows-update-windows-10 

3.	Make sure your graphics card driver is up-to-date.

4.	Make sure SteamVR is installed.

5.	Install WMR for SteamVR via Steam: http://store.steampowered.com/app/719950/Windows_Mixed_Reality_for_SteamVR/

6.	Run WMR for SteamVR and setup the boundary.

7.	Pair WMR controllers via WMR for SteamVR (by clicking the icon with 3 dots).

8.	Run Front Defense: Heroes

[h1]Troubleshooting:[/h1]
1.	You may need to activate Windows developer mode if you can’t run WMR for SteamVR normally, here is the link on how to activate it: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ayo4pefuYAY

2.	You may need to use an external Bluetooth dongle if your controllers do not work properly, see the Bluetooth best practice documentation here: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/mixed-reality/enthusiast-guide/troubleshooting-windows-mixed-reality#bluetooth-best-practices

3.	Your WMR HMD should be plugged into USB 3.0 port while your external Bluetooth dongle need to be plugged into USB 2.0 port.

4.	If you activated Windows developer mode, make sure you turn off the simulation for headphone and controllers in the developer options in WMR for SteamVR.

5.	Check out this link for more issues you may have: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/mixed-reality/enthusiast-guide/troubleshooting-windows-mixed-reality

notes.title: v0.94 Update
notes.content:
Greetings Soldiers!

[b]Smooth Locomotion Has Arrived![/b]

The wait is finally over - smooth locomotion has been implemented into the game!

This means that you will be able to play Front Defense Heroes running about in the game - guns blazing, bombs exploding, bullets whizzing past you - just as if you were on an actual battlefield!

We want to thank you for giving us your feedback on how important smooth locomotion is to you and for being patient with us while we worked hard to implement the feature amidst others.

Please tell us what you think of it and keep your constructive feedback and ideas coming. Also, look out for more updates soon as we have quite a lot of cool new features coming up!

Here’s the full list of updates below.

[list]
[*][h1]Game Settings[/h1]
We have revamped the game settings and it is now its own tab different from where you can select your Height, in-game name, movement style, Health bar settings and also added a section to allow users to change their graphic settings
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31409256/5be7422cc81feffb69b7f8bd4e474b9ce391476c.gif[/img]

[*][h1]Movement Options[/h1]
We have added two new movement types in the “Game Settings”

[b]-Locomotion[/b] - Smooth/free locomotion (Please take a rest or break if you feel dizzy or uncomfortable or select our Mixed or V-move options)

[b]-Mixed[/b] - A mix between our movement types where users can use both locomotion and V-move using their controller’s touchpad

[b]-V-move[/b] - Old movement style similar to teleport 

[*][h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
We found that with the additional of locomotion into our game that some of the guns needed to be balanced. We wanted there to be a variety of play styles and for all the weapon classes to feel unique.

[*][h1]-Sniper Rifles/Carbines[/h1]
With the additional of locomotion we have lowered the hip fire (1 handed) accuracy of the sniper rifles. Players will have to hold the gun with both hands to steady their aim and fire accurately.

[/list]

[h1]Upcoming Changes[/h1]
[b]-Control changes - [/b]In the next patch we will be removing the trigger option in the game settings menu and will be using the grip option as our default.

Join us over at Discord here to report bugs, give feedback and also to find games with other players! The devs are usually around so feel free to message us directly! https://discord.gg/R67Af6U

The wait is finally over - smooth locomotion has been implemented into the game!

This means that you will be able to play Front Defense Heroes running about in the game - guns blazing, bombs exploding, bullets whizzing past you - just as if you were on an actual battlefield!

We want to thank you for giving us your feedback on how important smooth locomotion is to you and for being patient with us while we worked hard to implement the feature amidst others.

Please tell us what you think of it and keep your constructive feedback and ideas coming. Also, look out for more updates soon as we have quite a lot of cool new features coming up!

Here’s the full list of updates below.

[list]
[*][h1]Game Settings[/h1]
We have revamped the game settings and it is now its own tab different from where you can select your Height, in-game name, movement style, Health bar settings and also added a section to allow users to change their graphic settings
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31409256/5be7422cc81feffb69b7f8bd4e474b9ce391476c.gif[/img]

[*][h1]Movement Options[/h1]
We have added two new movement types in the “Game Settings”

[b]-Locomotion[/b] - Smooth/free locomotion (Please take a rest or break if you feel dizzy or uncomfortable or select our Mixed or V-move options)

[b]-Mixed[/b] - A mix between our movement types where users can use both locomotion and V-move using their controller’s touchpad

[b]-V-move[/b] - Old movement style similar to teleport 

[*][h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
We found that with the additional of locomotion into our game that some of the guns needed to be balanced. We wanted there to be a variety of play styles and for all the weapon classes to feel unique.

[*][h1]-Sniper Rifles/Carbines[/h1]
With the additional of locomotion we have lowered the hip fire (1 handed) accuracy of the sniper rifles. Players will have to hold the gun with both hands to steady their aim and fire accurately.

[/list]

[h1]Upcoming Changes[/h1]
[b]-Control changes - [/b]In the next patch we will be removing the trigger option in the game settings menu and will be using the grip option as our default.

[h1]Discord Channel[/h1]
Join us over at Discord here to report bugs, give feedback and also to find games with other players! The devs are usually around so feel free to message us directly! https://discord.gg/R67Af6U

-Map, number of matches and number of players can be selected by host

We have also started a Discord channel for those of you who are looking for others to play with. Some of us (the devs) are also on from time to time if you would like chat and play with us!
[b]https://discord.gg/R67Af6U[/b] 

Our next update is coming up real soon, watch out for it!

Church graveyard: Fixed physical collision.


[/list]
